content.text:
Does this text message actually offer that CO will call THEM — Cue proposing to place an outbound call to the person, not just telling them how they can call Cue themselves — in any wording, even indirectly (e.g. "I'm here if you want to talk this through")? Not just related to talking or listening in general — specifically Cue offering to call them.

Message: "That's great news, congrats on locking it in.

Next I'd nail down the headcount and get it to them so they can confirm final seating, then sort the menu or any dietary restrictions, and send invites with an RSVP date so you're not chasing people the week of.

Want help with any one piece, like drafting the invite or an email to the venue about menu details?"

Return ONLY "yes" or "no".
